afirmacao.passagem: Snake venom zinc metalloproteinase that induces weak hemorrhage and mild myonecrosis. Shows mild myotoxicity by killing myocytes. Also induces edema in the mouse footpad at doses where hemorrhage is absent. In vitro, degrades laminin, fibronectin, and type IV collagen, suggesting this toxin play a role in local tissue damage by degrading extracellular matrix, and possibly by degrading muscle extracellular matrix. Hemorrhage is not due to cytotoxicity towards endothelial cells in culture, and may only play a minor role in local bleeding characteristic of L.muta envenomations. Also induces the synthesis of several endogenous matrix metalloproteinases, which in turn, may participate in extracellular matrix degradation
